notes.title: 1.2.112: Patch
notes.content:
Fix:
• Fixed a separate issue that would cause the ui blur to randomly activate.

notes.title: 1.2.111: Patch
notes.content:
Fixes:
• Bug where the background Ui blur would remain active after certain item inspections.
• Changed the trigger point for the closet scenario to prevent double events.
• Changed the audio fade duration to shorten the SQ6 music after interacting with the letter atop the overlook.

QOL:
• Added in-world ui hint for Rhonda's apartment key
• Added "Target" coordinates to the telescope as reference between planet instructions.

notes.title: 1.2.110: Patch
notes.content:
Fixes:
• Issue with npc navigation waypoint allocation losing reference
• World space interact ui elements would lose reference to the player camera 
• Sequence 6 statue door incorrectly attempting to re-trigger on save loads

Updates:
• Various code optimizations

notes.title: Patch: 1.2.109
notes.content:
Fixes:
• Fixed a critical issue where the cellphone could get stuck. Functionality for the wireless charger was removed to mitigate this issue until a proper fix can be found. Enjoy a never draining phone battery :D
• Fixed an issue where the default resolution would incorrectly allocate 640p (vomit).

notes.title: 1.2.98: Update
notes.content:
QOL:
• Added in game interaction ui cues on pertinent items.
• Various Ui Improvements

Some minor bug fixes as well.

notes.title: 1.2.96: Update
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Fixed issue where the interaction with the payphone would trigger the player movement prematurely
- Fixed bug where you could interact with the payphone too early.
- Fixed a bug where the player movement could be prematurely enabled for interactions
- Fixed a big allowing player movement after pausing the game and resuming

Enhancements:
- Further work to optimize load times.

notes.title: 1.2.95: Update
notes.content:
Fixed:
• Issue causing incorrect loaded data when loading a previous save, resulting in a lockout from the laptop
• Autosave could trigger at inappropriate moments resulting in corrupted save data
• Assetbundles would potentially not unload resulting in retained memory
• Interactable items were able to be triggered in various scenarios where they should not be.
• Resolution would automatically allocate incorrectly for new startups on the main menu screen to very low screen dimensions

Enhancements:
• Added text to the store site's print button
• Added a tip screen on load that informs of otherwise hidden mechanics
• Added failsafe positions the player will teleport to in the event that they clip through level geometry 
• Vsync option in the in-game settings menu

notes.title: 1.1.91: Update
notes.content:
Fixes: 
• Soft lock in extra closet scene when existing save data was loaded
• Stalker not disbanding upon reaching the final chapter
• Closet audio cue being incorrectly placed when active
• lag spike during a cutscene within the closet sequence

Updates: 
• Added light flickering to the platforms scene

notes.title: 1.1.90 - Update
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Dream sequence music trigger could be restarted 
- SQ1 dream tea thermos could be interacted with prematurely causing odd cutscene behavior
- Flathead dialogue would not fire 
- Soft locked movement after SQ6 cabin dialogue was triggered
- Player was able to clip through the sewer interior pipes.

Updates:
- Further enhancement to shader compilation and scene load

notes.title: 1.0.89 - Fixes and Optimizations
notes.content:
- Fixed the player light cone incorrectly triggering colliders
- Fixed slides firing for subsequent playthroughs
- Adjusted shader compilation to further reduce load times and in-game stutters
